scenes.heading: Container Package & Embeds
scenes.narration: Maven. Container Package & Embeds. In this video we review 7 key concepts you need to know for the certification.

scenes.question: What should the all package include as embeds?
scenes.heading: Only deployable artifacts such as the core bundle JAR and the ui.apps, ui.config, and ui.content packages
scenes.body: Section 6 says the all package is a container and includes only deployable artifacts as embeds: the core bundle JAR and the ui.apps, ui.config, and ui.content packages.

scenes.question: What must the all package not contain?
scenes.heading: Any content or code of its own

scenes.question: Which FileVault plugin configuration should be used to include packages in the container?
scenes.heading: embeddeds
scenes.body: Section 6 says packages are included with the embeddeds configuration of the FileVault package Maven plugin, and that the older subPackages configuration is not used.

scenes.question: Which older configuration does the speech say is not used for embedding packages?
scenes.heading: subPackages
scenes.body: The lesson contrasts embeddeds with the older subPackages configuration and says subPackages is not used.

scenes.question: Where are embedded packages placed inside the container package?
scenes.heading: /apps/<app-name>-packages/(content|application|container)/install(.author|.publish)?
scenes.body: Section 6 gives the exact target-path pattern for embedded packages: /apps/<app-name>-packages/(content|application|container)/install(.author|.publish)?.

scenes.question: Why does the second-level folder use the suffix -packages?
scenes.heading: To prevent embedded packages from being deployed into the application's own target folders under /apps/<app-name>
scenes.body: The speech says the -packages suffix is a convention that prevents embedded packages from being deployed into the target folders of the application under /apps/<app-name>, which would cause destructive or cyclic installation.

scenes.question: Which run-mode-specific embedded package folders are supported?
scenes.heading: install.author and install.publish only
scenes.body: Section 6 says only install.author and install.publish are supported; other run modes are not.
